name: Wave Lines
description: Evenly stacked wave lines that draw in from the left and then undulate slowly behind your content.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of wave lines, stacked evenly from top to bottom.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Height of the waves above and below their rest line, in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one rise and fall at any point on a line.

props.name: colors
props.description: Stroke colours, cycled down the stack. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the lines. Other div props are passed through.
